Class SyntheticClassType

java.lang.Object
sootup.core.types.Type
sootup.core.types.ReferenceType
sootup.core.types.ClassType
sootup.spark.node.SyntheticClassType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Acceptor<TypeVisitor>, Signature
public final class SyntheticClassType extends ClassType
A class that only exists inside SPARK, e.g. the owner of its global scope and of the pseudo field of array elements. It never equals a class of the analyzed program, even one with the same name: ClassType.equals(Object) compares the implementation class.
